verdict.rationale: Teller documents a transactions API that exposes an account's ledger transactions, and its list endpoint supports pagination controls. A community user reports building a CSV/QIF export script on the API. Webhooks fire when changes are detected in enrollments or financial data, which partly supports keeping data in sync, but no incremental fetch-only-changes mechanism is documented. missing for 10: documented history depth (how far back transactions go), a documented delta/cursor sync pattern for fetching only changed transactions, detail on how pagination works.
